requirements.summary: Redesign LandingPage into an immersive, section-by-section “traveling through a tool shed” journey while preserving existing primary CTA behaviors and auth-dependent actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Homepage content is clearly themed as an immersive tool-shed journey (e.g., a sequence of sections that feels like moving through a shed/workshop)

Existing CTA behaviors remain intact: unauthenticated users see Get Started/Sign Up actions calling login; authenticated users see List a Tool navigating to /add-listing; Browse Tools navigates to /browse
Uses substantially more visuals than the current homepage (multiple graphics/illustrations/background elements beyond a single hero image)
Layout is responsive from mobile to desktop and does not overflow or clip key content

file_operations.description: Rebuild the page structure into a multi-section “journey through the shed” narrative (entrance/aisle/workbench/signage/exit CTA), keep the existing Browse Tools navigation, and preserve auth-dependent CTAs by continuing to use useInternetIdentity().login for unauthenticated actions and navigation to /add-listing for authenticated users. Continue using shadcn-ui Button/Card where appropriate for consistent CTAs and content blocks; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a small presentational component to standardize each journey ‘stop’ (section layout, heading/label styling, optional image slots, and consistent padding/containers) to keep LandingPage maintainable while implementing the immersive sequence. Use shadcn-ui Card (and/or existing typography styles) as needed for section callouts; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the new ToolshedJourneySection component into the LandingPage so it is not orphaned, and ensure responsive behavior (mobile stacking, safe image sizing, and no overflow) across all journey sections.

requirements.summary: Implement and apply a cohesive toolshed-travel visual theme on the homepage only, without changing global app layout (header/footer) behavior or editing immutable paths.
acceptanceCriteria: Homepage styling reads as a unified theme (colors, typography accents, section backgrounds, and visual motifs align)
Does not require edits to immutable paths (e.g., frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/*, frontend/src/components/ui/*)
Header and footer remain functional and readable on top of any new homepage backgrounds (no contrast/accessibility regressions)

file_operations.description: Apply a consistent ‘warm workshop’ theme within the homepage via Tailwind classes (wood/metal tones, signage/labels, textured section backdrops, sticker overlays) while keeping header/footer untouched. Ensure the top hero/backdrops do not reduce header readability (maintain sufficient contrast under the sticky translucent header). Use shadcn-ui Button styling variants for CTAs to remain consistent with the rest of the app; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Extend Tailwind theme with homepage-safe utilities needed for the toolshed theme (e.g., additional keyframes/animations, optional extra shadows/filters) without changing global layout behavior. Ensure any additions support mobile responsiveness and do not require edits to immutable paths.

requirements.summary: Add subtle, performant motion effects to reinforce the feeling of traveling through the shed, respecting prefers-reduced-motion and avoiding scroll jank.
acceptanceCriteria: Animations are subtle and do not block interaction or navigation
If the user has prefers-reduced-motion enabled, animations are reduced/disabled appropriately
No noticeable jank during scroll on modern desktop/mobile browsers (avoid heavy runtime effects)

file_operations.description: Add lightweight keyframes/animation utilities for homepage-only use (e.g., slow drifting dust motes, gentle light-beam shimmer, small signage sway) that can be gated behind Tailwind’s motion-safe/motion-reduce variants to respect reduced-motion preferences.

Apply the new motion utilities to non-interactive decorative layers (e.g., dust mote overlays, subtle sticker float, gentle gradient movement) using motion-safe / motion-reduce variants so animations are disabled/reduced when the user prefers reduced motion, and ensure motion layers never block clicks/taps on CTAs.

Support optional decorative motion hooks (e.g., animated corner stickers or section ‘sign’ accents) at the section component level using motion-safe/motion-reduce classes so the travel vibe is consistent across sections. Verify any shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add and reference the newly generated static homepage image assets under frontend/public/assets/generated, and ensure the LandingPage renders them without broken links.
acceptanceCriteria: All new images are stored as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated
LandingPage renders the new images and they load correctly in the browser (no broken links)

file_operations.description: Add the generated static hero scene image to be used by the redesigned LandingPage.
Add the generated transparent sticker sheet image to be used as decorative overlays within the redesigned LandingPage.
Add the generated tileable wood texture image to be used as a subtle background texture on homepage sections.
Add the generated workbench banner image for a mid-journey section on the redesigned LandingPage.
Add the edited/shifted hero image (toolshed vibe variant) for use as the primary hero visual in the redesigned LandingPage.

Update the homepage to reference and render the new static assets from: frontend/public/assets/generated/toolshed-journey-hero.dim_1600x900.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/toolshed-ui-stickers.dim_1400x900.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/toolshed-wood-texture.dim_1024x1024.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/workbench-banner.dim_1600x600.png, and frontend/public/assets/generated/toolshare-hero-toolshed.dim_1600x900.png. Ensure image sizing is responsive and does not cause overflow/clipping.
